description: National weekly boxed beef cutout and individual cut prices (LM_XB459). Returns composite primal values (rib, chuck, round, loin, brisket, plate, flank), Choice and Select cutout values, individual box/cut prices by grade, ground beef, and trimming prices. Published Thursdays. Source: USDA LMPR Datamart, US Government public domain.
